mapper.select: SELECT WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID /* 운동기록아이디 */ , WR.USER_ID /* 회원아이디 */ , WR.CATEGORY_CD /* 카테고리코드 */ , WR.RECORD_DT /* 기록일시 */ , WR.DURATION_MIN /* 운동시간(분) */ , WR.REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , WR.MOD_DT /* 변경일시 */ , LISTAGG(BP.BODY_PART_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY BP.BODY_PART_NM) AS BODY_PART_NMS /* 부위명 목록(쉼표 구분, 중복 제거) */ FROM WORKOUT_RECORD WR LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT WRE.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID, CCD.DTL_CD_NM AS BODY_PART_NM FROM WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE WRE JOIN EXERCISES E ON E.EXERCISE_ID = WRE.EXERCISE_ID JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL CCD ON CCD.COM_CD_ID = 'BODY_PART_CD' AND CCD.DTL_CD_ID = E.BODY_PART_CD ) BP ON BP.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID = WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID WHERE WR.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} GROUP BY WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID, WR.USER_ID, WR.CATEGORY_CD, WR.RECORD_DT, WR.DURATION_MIN, WR.REG_DT, WR.MOD_DT ORDER BY WR.RECORD_DT DESC

SELECT WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID /* 운동기록아이디 */ , WR.USER_ID /* 회원아이디 */ , WR.CATEGORY_CD /* 카테고리코드 */ , WR.RECORD_DT /* 기록일시 */ , WR.DURATION_MIN /* 운동시간(분) */ , WR.REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , WR.MOD_DT /* 변경일시 */ , WRE.WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE_ID /* 상세기록아이디 */ , WRE.EXERCISE_ID /* 운동아이디 */ , E.NAME AS EXERCISE_NAME /* 운동명 */ , WRE.SORT_NO /* 상세기록 내 운동 정렬순서 */ , WRS.WORKOUT_RECORD_SET_ID /* 세트기록아이디 */ , WRS.SET_NO /* 세트번호 */ , WRS.WEIGHT /* 중량 */ , WRS.REPS /* 횟수 */ FROM WORKOUT_RECORD WR LEFT JOIN WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE WRE ON WRE.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID = WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID LEFT JOIN EXERCISES E ON E.EXERCISE_ID = WRE.EXERCISE_ID LEFT JOIN WORKOUT_RECORD_SET WRS ON WRS.WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE_ID = WRE.WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE_ID WHERE WR.WORKOUT_RECORD_ID = #{workoutRecordId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND WR.USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY WRE.SORT_NO, WRS.SET_NO
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WORKOUT_RECORD_EXERCISE WHERE WORKOUT_RECORD_ID = #{workoutRecordId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
